The successful bidder is required to submit the Performance Security/ Warranty Bond @5% of total supp ly order value covering delivery period + warranty+ 02 months or as period specified in the bid in favour o f Director, Defence Laboratory Jodhpur in shape of BG or FDR only issued by any of nationalized bank or s cheduled private bank as approved by RBI . In the event of the seller’s failure to submit the BG within 30 d ays of receipt of the supply order/ siging of contract, the buyer will deduct from the seller , a sum of 0.5% o f the value of the BG for every week or part thereof of delay as LD. Delivery Terms: FOR DLJ. Further, the delivery period mentioned in the supply order cover complete sco pe of supply, installation, testing , commissioning and training (if required) at DLJ 7. The delivery of the item should be made on working days i.e Monday to Friday between 0900 hours to 1 700 hours. In case the last date of delivery falls on Saturday/ Sunday/ Holiday, the final date of delivery sh ould be considered working day prior date of such holiday. 8. The visit report will be issued to the firm which should be enclosed with technical bid failing which offer will be rejected 8.3 The Industry Partner/ collaborating agency should have an established design and manufacturing mac hines and equipment viz CNC , welding system, advanced tools etc with adequate space for fabrication an d qualified technical manpower 9. nce security before the deadline defined in RFP document, we may be suspended for the period upto 2 yea rs from being eligible to submit the bids for contract with any of the procuring entities of DRDO. .
